doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The teddy bear and her first singing, and pay of $175
summary: She sang Melancholy Baby for a man's gift of a bear, was paid $175, until her parents stopped it.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Now, tell us about your first singing engagement there, how it came about. And at that point, had you made the decision to become a singer before the gentleman asked you to sing the tune, or was it really something that took you completely by surprise?
When he brought that beautiful teddy bear there, and I looked at him, and I said . . .
I‘m sorry, Miss Horn, to interrupt you. Can you just back up and tell the story so that whoever‘s listening knows why he brought [unclear]?

Okay. This was a dining room that I was, you know, sneaked my age. At that time you had to be eighteen to play in where they served alcohol. Okay. Well, I changed my age, and this old man would come in. He was so fine. He was good looking, debonair, you know. He came every evening and had dinner, and he‘d just tip his hat and leave. And he was a good-looking dude, you know? Okay. It‘s getting closer to Christmas, and this time he came in and I just knew that was my bear. The bear was as tall as I, beautiful turquoise bear. And I said, ―I know that‘s my bear.‖
And he sent me a little note up to the piano. ―If you sing Melancholy Baby, that‘s your bear.‖ And I sang Melancholy Baby, honey. [laughs] I had that bear, oh god, for years and years.
After that, did you incorporate singing into your . . .

Yeah. Well, your daddy would know about Clara Bow, who was a great singer; Clara Bow, great singer and pianist. And see, she was there, and she kind of was looking out for me and stuff, and she went to Olivia and said, ―She can sing. So, she‘s gotta get more money.‖ Well, that was cool, because since I could sing, I got $175 for five days, five days a week and two hours. So that was a whole lot of money then.
Was it? That was a decent pay for a musician?
That was a lot of money, child, $175. So, it didn‘t last long. Then my mother found out what was happening. My dad and mom came in and that was the end of that. Then they just acted ugly.
